notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a counter on a permanent or player.
description:
Activate Zur by paying {1}{W}, causing All Will Be One to become an enchantment creature until end of turn.
Cast Triumph of the Hordes by paying {2}{G}{G}, giving creatures you control +1/+1 and infect until end of turn.
Put a counter on a permanent or player.
All Will Be One triggers, giving an opponent a poison counter and causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat step 4.
